title: File:Clock (tic tac).ogg
author: Saaabaaato
used_as: sound: the clock of the present room, ticks cut individually (hiss gated out) and re-laid at 1 Hz from 1.75 s; muffled + reverberant in S2

title: File:Closing an old door.ogg
author: ezwa
used_as: sound: ROOM TONE: the quiet stretches between its events, looped with crossfades at -50 dBFS (present dry, S2 muffled); its strongest event as the shadow-play door

title: File:Door handle creaking.ogg
author: stephan
used_as: sound: S2a door latch (muffled) at 9.17 s

title: File:Squeaky door hinge.ogg
author: MKFI
used_as: sound: S2a door swinging open; pitched up 1.7x as the box-lid hinge when the aunt opens it (S2c, muffled)

title: File:Cupboarddoorclose.ogg
author: Secretlondon
used_as: sound: box lid: muffled lid shut inside the swallow (17.0 s), dry lid click when she closes it (39.5 s), clasp tick (7.75 s)

title: File:Knocking on wood or door.ogg
author: stephan
used_as: sound: single knocks low-passed to 900 Hz as heel steps on parquet (S2a), and to 1.4 kHz as the box set down on a lap / into hands

title: File:Book paper pages assorted.ogg
author: stephan
used_as: sound: receipt slip landing and settling, three unfolds, receipt laid in the velvet slot; one slow movement low-passed as cloth rustle (his hand to his knee)

title: File:Assorted creaking noises of office chair.ogg
